job.domain: a coding assistant working in a repository

items.text: The Harbourview Hotel in Rotherhithe offers 84 rooms, most with partial river views. Check-in begins at 15:00 and check-out is 11:00; early check-in is subject to availability and can be requested at the front desk but not guaranteed. Our recently refurbished lounge bar serves light meals until 22:30, and the fitness room is open to guests around the clock with a room key. Breakfast is included in all direct bookings, and cancellation is free up to 48 hours before arrival. Guests travelling with pets should note that only the ground-floor Garden rooms accept dogs, with a modest nightly fee.

Booking a visit to the Aldermere Museum is straightforward, but timed tickets do sell out during school holidays. Entry to the permanent collections is free, while the special exhibitions carry a charge and require a slot booked in advance through the website. The museum's online assistant can answer questions about opening hours and accessibility, but it cannot reserve tickets, so you'll still need to complete the checkout yourself. Lockers are available in the basement for a refundable deposit, and large bags are not permitted in the galleries. Photography without flash is allowed throughout, except in the temporary exhibition space on level 2.

We are deprecating the v2 REST endpoints described below, with a hard shutdown planned for 30 November. All v2 traffic should migrate to the v3 API, which uses the same authentication scheme but returns paginated responses by default. During the transition period, v2 requests will continue to work but every response will carry a `Sunset` header with the date, and clients that read the header can log a warning. Our support chatbot does not yet understand the difference between the two versions, so please direct migration questions to the developer forum rather than the widget on the docs page. The changelog lists every field that was renamed or removed.

The Grange Park Hotel sits a ten-minute walk from the station and a short bus ride from the city centre. Rooms are compact but clean, and the staff were friendly throughout our three-night stay.

Breakfast is a self-service buffet with a decent selection of pastries, fruit and cooked options. We found the restaurant quiet in the evenings, which suited us, though the bar closes earlier than the website suggests. The reception staff mentioned that the hotel uses an automated tool to assign rooms, which sometimes puts families on different floors; they were happy to move us when we asked at check-in.

Wifi worked reliably on both floors we stayed on. Parking is limited to about a dozen spaces and costs extra, so it's worth confirming when you book. Overall, good value for the price, and we'd stay again if we needed somewhere close to the station.

The Fernbank Museum's new Wing C extension opens to the public on 14 March. It houses the ceramics collection previously kept in storage, along with a small café and a cloakroom. Members can preview the galleries during the members' weekend on 8-9 March; no separate booking is needed, just bring your card. Accessibility improvements include step-free access from the north entrance and a Changing Places toilet on the ground floor. The museum's website assistant can help you plan a route between galleries, though it occasionally suggests closed sections, so always check the printed floor plan at the entrance.

The following table summarises the retirement schedule for the payments API. All dates are in UTC and have been communicated to integrators in the February newsletter.

| Endpoint | Deprecated | Sunset | Replacement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/v2/charges` | 2024-01-15 | 2024-07-01 | `/v3/payments` |
| `/v2/refunds` | 2024-01-15 | 2024-07-01 | `/v3/refunds` |
| `/v2/customers` | 2024-02-01 | 2024-08-01 | `/v3/customers` |
| `/v2/webhooks` | 2024-03-01 | 2024-09-01 | `/v3/events` |

Requests to sunset endpoints return HTTP 410 after the date. If you have an automated tool that polls these endpoints, update its configuration before the cutoff to avoid failed runs.

Planning a day at the Kirkstone Museum of Transport is easiest if you arrive before eleven, when the volunteer guides begin their short talks in the engine hall. The café serves hot food until three, and there is a picnic area near the canal entrance for those bringing their own lunch. Children's activity trails are available from the front desk for a small charge, and most families complete them in under an hour. The museum's friendly front-of-house chatbot on the website can point you to the nearest bus stop, but it isn't connected to the ticket system, so buy tickets on arrival or through the standard checkout page.

Booking direct with the Ashcombe Lodge saves you the commission that the big travel sites add, and the rates on our own page are always the lowest available. Our three room types differ mainly in size and view: the Standard faces the courtyard, the Deluxe overlooks the garden, and the Loft Suite has a small kitchenette. Weekend stays require a two-night minimum from May to September. If you need a cot or an extra bed, mention it in the notes field and reception will confirm within a day; our booking chatbot can also answer questions about facilities, though it can't modify an existing reservation.

Migrating away from v2 of the notifications API is mostly mechanical, but there are a few traps worth knowing about before you start.

The biggest change is that v3 replaces the `subscriptions` object with a flat list of `channels`, each of which carries its own delivery preferences. Previously, a single account-level setting controlled retries; now retries are configured per channel, and the default is three attempts rather than five. If your code relies on the old retry count, set it explicitly in each channel entry.

A second difference is pagination. v2 returned up to 100 records per page and used a simple `page` parameter, whereas v3 returns 50 by default and uses cursor-based links provided in the `next` field. Many teams discover this the hard way when an automated tool that syncs notifications silently stops after the first page. Update the sync job to follow the cursor until it is absent.

Finally, the sandbox environment has been rebuilt, and the old test fixtures no longer exist. Generate fresh fixtures with the CLI command below, then re-run your integration tests against the sandbox before pointing anything at production.

```bash
notifctl sandbox fixtures generate --channels email,sms,push
```

The Brackenhill Hotel's conference wing can be booked separately from the guest rooms, which suits small training days of up to forty people. Three meeting rooms are available, each with a projector, whiteboard and flipchart, and lunch can be added for a per-head charge. Bookings for the conference wing are handled by a different team from the bedrooms, so if you need both, mention it when enquiring and the coordinator will combine the two quotes. A virtual assistant on the website can check room availability by date, but it cannot confirm catering or equipment requests.
